column1: # fx.rate_spread_db probe note (2026-10-13, F14): Bitcrush's 6 kHz probe sits on its default 6 kHz hold rate, so a correct hold samples the tone at its zero crossings and reads silence (-240 dBFS) at every rate; the -80 dBFS floor drops that band and Bitcrush is gated on 100 Hz and 1 kHz. Evidence: the old kernel with no start-up ramp still read -26.8 / -23.1 / -28.2 dBFS (holds one host sample early); the fixed clock with the ramp read -30.1 / -25.2 / -30.1 (the mailbox's ramp from 0 left a per-rate clock phase); fixed clock plus primed mailbox -240 at all three. A non-zero reading there is clock phase, not level.
